notes.title: September 2025 Big Update!
notes.notes: [p]A Quick list of changes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimization. The game should run much smoother, at a higher framerate, and be able to handle many more blocks at once.[/p][/*][*][p]CPU Controlled Players. Dont' have a friend to play with? Thats ok! Now You can play verus the computer. It's still pretty dumb, but gets the job dumb. This should improve in future patches. You can even do CPU vs CPU and watch them go at it![/p][/*][*][p]More Trophies[/p][/*][*][p]More Puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]The Ability To change modes without returning to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the Puzzle Selection Screen[/p][/*][*][p]Some Gameplay improvements regarding difficulty, More differences between difficulty levels, and the game should be a little more forgiving in general.[/p][/*][/list][p]It's been a minute since an update! It's been a tough year, the computer I was working on Crashed last christmas morning and I lost about 3 monthes of work because I am bad about backing things up. I also had to start working full time so It's been slower going. But I'm not giving up![/p]

notes.title: Time Trial UI Buff and More Bug Fixes 8-25-2024
notes.notes:
-Resolved a bug where hold function wasn’t working
-Fixed an issue where the back sprite for the pause menu doesn't fade in on loss.
-Fixed a bug where modes swapped on unpausing when it shouldn’t.
-Added a Flashing red element to the timer when you are almost out of time on time trial.

notes.notes: I'm going to try and patch more often

notes.title: Local Multiplayer added! New puzzle mode Added! Rough but Large Patch!
notes.notes: This patch introduces many features that are working well on my machine, I'm still learning how to test enough before patching to steam so There will be some follow up patches that will address some issues that are probably going to come up. I will drop a detailed patch notes list later but i've been working on it for over a year so is too much to type right now in case I have to revert changes.
